title: 第7章 意外之喜上古血玉第8章 瞎猫撞上死耗子
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
没过多久。
他们便来到了天河赌石行，二人刚要进门，就听旁边传来一阵讥笑：“一个死瞎子跑到赌石行来凑热闹，楚天铭，你是不是走错门了？”
楚天铭扭头看去，只见一个身穿锦衣玉带的年轻男子，在十几个武者的簇拥下，走了过来。
此人不是别人，正是四大家族李家少主李斌。
这位李家少主，是有名的纨绔世子，不学无术，平日里除了勾栏听曲，就是赌石。
楚天铭以前虽然没有看到过他的模样，但是从声音也能分的清楚。
“赌石行又不是你们李家开的，你都能来，我怎么不能来？”
楚天铭回道。
李斌冷冷一笑，随即看了眼旁边身姿曼妙的韩清雪，嘲讽道：“死瞎子，现在有韩家大小姐给你撑腰，便敢还嘴了是么？”
“李斌，你别没完没了，到处咬人。”
韩清雪上前一步，目光冰冷的看着李斌。
李斌虽然不怕楚天铭，但是却知道韩家不是好惹的，所以冷哼一声，不再多言，然后带着自己的手下，浩浩荡荡的进入了赌石行。
“天铭，不用搭理这种人。”
“没事，我们也进去吧。”
楚天铭微微一笑，不以为然，拉起韩清雪便走入赌石行内。
虽然是清晨，但是赌石行内，却已经爆满，近百丈方圆的大厅内，已然挤满了人。
在大厅中央，则是放置着上百块大小不一的原石。
“诸位，这批原石，可都是咱们大隋青和田矿区运来的，个个都是精品原石，很有可能从里面开出上古宝玉等极品宝物，当然价格也都不菲，最便宜的一块原石，也要一千两黄金，没有实力的人，可不要乱来。”
赌行老板，是一个大腹便便的中年男子，一双小眼睛眯成了一道缝，看向四周的众人。
“张老板，你这赌石也卖的太贵了吧，就算是青和田矿区的原石，也不值一千两黄金啊！”

“就是，就是。”
众人纷纷摇头，显然都被这价格吓到了，毕竟一千两黄金，可以买很多普通原石了。
就连一向财大气粗的李斌都是摸了摸下巴。
楚天铭也苦笑一下，自己身上的这些黄金，竟然够买一块原石的，如此一来，他就有一次机会，根本没有试错的可能。
看来，他必须看准才能出手。
想到这里，楚天铭没有着急，开启轮回天目，向着那些原石看了过去。
在轮回天目之下，这些原石上的纹路，瞬间放大数十倍，清晰无比的在他眼底当中呈现出来。
很快，他便锁定了两块原石。
这两块原石，纹路清晰，且连贯有序，最主要的是，他能感受到里面有淡淡的灵韵呈现。
按照观石术上记载，凡是有灵韵的原石，里面必然会有宝物。
见此，楚天铭不再犹豫，立刻指着其中一块较小的原石道：“这块原石我要了。”
众人一惊，没想到真有人当冤大头，目光纷纷，向着楚天铭看了过去，随即全部怔在了原地。
一个瞎子，竟然跑到这里赌石，这不是在开玩笑？
“呵呵，楚天铭，你一个瞎子，连原石是什么都不知道，就敢跑到这赌石，你脑子不是进水了吧。”
李斌自然不放过这个嘲讽楚天铭的机会，立刻开口讥讽道。
此话一出，大厅内顿时传来一片哄笑。
楚天铭却懒得搭理这家伙，指了指那块较小的原石道：“老板，这块原石帮我切开可好？”
那张老板也是有些诧异的看着楚天铭：“楚公子，这块原石，你真的要切？”
楚天铭点了点头：“对。”
content_en:
It didn't take long.
They arrived at the Tianhe Stone Gambling Shop. Just as they were about to enter, they heard a burst of ridicule from the side: "A blind man came to the Stone Gambling Shop to join in the fun. Chu Tianming, did you go to the wrong door?"
Chu Tianming turned around and saw a young man wearing brocade clothes and jade belt walking over, surrounded by a dozen warriors.
This person is none other than Li Bin, the young master of the Li family of the four major families.
The young master of the Li family is a well-known dandy with no knowledge or skills. In addition to listening to music on weekdays, he also gambles on stones.
Although Chu Tianming had never seen his appearance before, he could tell the difference clearly from his voice.
"It's not like your Li family runs the Stone Gambling Shop. You can come, so why can't I come?"
Chu Tianming replied.
Li Bin smiled coldly, then glanced at the graceful Han Qingxue next to him, and said mockingly: "You damn blind man, now that you have the support of the eldest lady of the Han family, you dare to talk back, right?"
"Li Bin, don't go on biting people everywhere."
Han Qingxue took a step forward and looked at Li Bin with cold eyes.
Although Li Bin was not afraid of Chu Tianming, he knew that the Han family was not easy to mess with, so he snorted coldly, said no more, and then led his men into the Stone Gambling Shop in a mighty manner.
"Tian Ming, don't pay attention to this kind of person."
"It's okay, let's go in too."
Chu Tianming smiled slightly, disapprovingly, pulled Han Qingxue up and walked into the stone gambling shop.
Although it was early in the morning, the Stone Gambling Shop was already full, and the nearly one hundred feet square hall was already packed with people.
In the center of the hall, there are hundreds of rough stones of different sizes.
"Everyone, these rough stones are all shipped from our Great Sui Qing Hotan Mining Area. All of them are high-quality rough stones. It is very likely that ancient jade and other top-quality treasures can be found from them. Of course, they are also expensive. The cheapest piece of rough stone costs one thousand taels of gold. People who have no strength should not mess around."
The boss of the gambling shop was a middle-aged man with a big belly. His small eyes narrowed to a slit and he looked at the people around him.
"Boss Zhang, your gambling stones are too expensive. Even the rough stones from the Qinghetian mining area are not worth a thousand taels of gold!"
"That's right, that's right."
Everyone shook their heads, obviously frightened by the price. After all, one thousand taels of gold could buy a lot of ordinary rough stones.
Even Li Bin, who has always been wealthy, touched his chin.
Chu Tianming also smiled bitterly. The gold he had on his body was enough to buy a rough stone. In this way, he had a chance, and there was no possibility of trial and error.
It seemed that he had to be precise before he could take action.
Thinking of this, Chu Tianming was not in a hurry, opened his samsara celestial eye, and looked at the rough stones.
Under the eyes of reincarnation, the lines on these original stones were magnified dozens of times in an instant, appearing clearly in his eyes.
Soon, he locked two rough stones.
The textures of these two rough stones were clear and coherent. The most important thing was that he could feel a faint spiritual charm inside.
According to the records of stone observation, any rough stone with aura must have treasures inside.
Seeing this, Chu Tianming no longer hesitated and immediately pointed to one of the smaller rough stones and said, "I want this rough stone."
Everyone was shocked. They didn't expect that someone would really be taken advantage of. They all looked at Chu Tianming, and then they all froze on the spot.
A blind man came here to bet on stones. Isn't this a joke?
"Haha, Chu Tianming, you are a blind man, you don't even know what the original stone is, and you dare to come here to gamble on stones, you are not out of your mind."
Li Bin naturally did not miss this opportunity to ridicule Chu Tianming and immediately spoke sarcastically.
As soon as these words came out, there was a burst of laughter in the hall.
Chu Tianming was too lazy to pay attention to this guy. He pointed at the smaller rough stone and said, "Boss, can you help me cut this rough stone?"
That boss Zhang also has someHe looked at Chu Tianming in surprise: "Mr. Chu, do you really want to cut this rough stone?"
Chu Tianming nodded: "Yes."
